== Biography ==
Elizabeth Dickerson GLASGOW was born 30 Jul 1844 in Tennessee, United States. 

She passed away 06 Mar 1924 in Fort Worth, Tarrant, Texas, United States. BURIAL Hillsdale Cemetery Macon County, Tennessee, USA.

Children:
* Infant Uhls (unknown–1875)
* Martha Ellen Uhles Eller (1855–1946)
* Richard Henry Uhls (1859–1876)
* Jennie Uhles (1867–1887)
* Aurie E Uhles Porter (1869–1950)
* Verlonia B. Uhls (1876–1878)
* William Andrew Uhles (878–1959)
* Jesse F Uhles (1889–1899)

== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-2476]] is assessed at 94% (proved). The held 1850 census index places this same-surname child in Neely Glassgow’s Smith County household, matched to Wesley by the 1860/1870 sequence and Charley’s father record. Elizabeth D recurs in 1860, with her distinctive middle initial and compatible age.

Confidence concerns this recorded child and the selected father as identified by the held family evidence; maternity and the father’s upstream ancestry are separate.

Next useful test: Inspect 1850/1860 household pages and a child’s full death-parent entry.

Source basis already held: [https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:MCDC-2BQ "United States Census, 1850," database with images, FamilySearch (https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:MCDC-2BQ : 20 October 2021), Elizabeth D Glassgow in household of Neely Glassgow, Smith, Tennessee, United States; citing family , NARA microfilm publication (Washington, D.C.: National Archives and Records Administration, n.d.).].
